title: A person's SIGINT stop of a foreground run-epic reads as the failed class (run_died → exit 1), the same conflation rix removed for cancelled words
description:
cli.go's signal handler writes a run_died ('stopped by a signal (interrupt) before the run finished') for a person's Ctrl-C, and the watch classifies every run_died as FAILED/1 with 'the work has to be fixed and the epic run again'. A deliberate person-stop is the cancelled class's own case, not a failure to fix — the same distinction this tick made for the run_finished cancelled words. A future tick could split the deliberate signal stop from real deaths (an eviction, a panic) before the run_died stage, or teach the classifier the signal-stop detail.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 39605bc328cc83cec4998e950249bfd749da04b7a8032dd5e72724ffdb3fb674 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-rix/attempt-45): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/39605bc328cc83cec4998e950249bfd749da04b7a8032dd5e72724ffdb3fb674.json on the run branch.
